$comment: Work graph for the GoodSport v2 PR. Nodes are work packages; dependsOn edges are hard contract dependencies. Build order = topological sort (ties alphabetical). estimate is relative size for the critical path.

decisions.persistence: Neon Postgres (Netlify DB) via Drizzle, behind the TeamRepo interface; the JSON file repo stays for local dev, tests, and seeding. Chosen over Netlify Blobs because the identity model (users, sessions, tokens, households, audit) is relational and the PR is meant to be the durable foundation.
decisions.identity: Coaches/admin: email 6-digit code or link (Resend, console fallback in dev) issuing server-side sessions. Parents: signed family links texted by the coach, plus a claim-by-masked-email fallback. No passwords anywhere. Legacy COACH_PASSCODE stays as a shim until both coaches have signed in.
decisions.snack: Generic Signup slots (role: snack) so volunteer sign-ups come free later; one slot per game; parent claim requires a household session; coach can assign/clear anything.

verifiers.title: Contracts
verifiers.instructions: Confirm every listed export exists at the stated path with the stated name, is consumed by at least one caller or test, and that predecessors' exports are imported rather than redefined. grep is your friend.

verifiers.title: Checks
verifiers.instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build on the node's commit. Confirm new pure logic has unit tests and each new route handler or server action has at least one request-level test. Fail on any skipped or focused test.

verifiers.title: Security
verifiers.instructions: Check every new write path for server-side authorization (requireRole / requireHousehold) before any read of private data; zod validation on all inputs; no PII (guardian phone/email, DOB, medical, full child last name) in public routes, public DTOs, client component props, logs, or commits; rate limits where docs/reviews/03-security.md requires them; secrets only from env. Fail with file:line.

verifiers.title: Simplicity
verifiers.instructions: Start the app (npm run build && npx next start) and load the node's screens at 400px and 1280px with Playwright (executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium). Check docs/reviews/01-design-ux.md section 4 for the affected audience: tap targets >=48px, undo not confirm dialogs, no developer copy (file paths, env var names) outside Settings, primary action visible without scrolling on phone, works with keyboard focus visible.

verifiers.title: Reuse
verifiers.instructions: grep the diff for sport-specific branching (soccer, goal, pitch, quarter) in components, actions, or prompts. New behavior must read from SportTemplate. Confirm the tball template still renders every touched screen without errors.

nodes.title: Database foundation and repository interface
nodes.goal: Replace JSON-in-git as the runtime store with Neon Postgres via Drizzle, behind a TeamRepo interface, without changing any page's behavior. Keep the JSON file repo for local dev and tests, and add an import script that loads data/teams/*.json plus the private overlay (file or PRIVATE_CONTACTS_JSON) into the database.
exports: src/lib/db/schema.ts: Drizzle tables orgs, seasons, teams, share_codes, players, households, guardians, player_guardians, events, signups, users, memberships, sessions, tokens, family_sessions, audit_log

src/lib/data/repo.ts: interface TeamRepo { listTeamSlugs; loadTeam(slug, {includePrivate}); loadTeamByShareCode(code); saveEvent; deleteEvent; saveSignup; getSignups(teamId); rotateShareCode; appendAudit }
src/lib/data/repo.ts: getRepo(): TeamRepo selected by DATA_BACKEND=postgres|fs (fs default when DATABASE_URL unset)
src/lib/data/repo.ts: TeamData gains signups: Signup[] and households: Household[]
scripts/import-seed.ts: npm run db:import loads seeds and the contacts overlay idempotently
acceptance: With DATABASE_URL unset, every existing page renders identically (snapshot the HTML of /team/tottenham-fall-2026 and /t/<code> before and after).
With DATABASE_URL set to a local Postgres (docker or Neon branch), npm run db:import then the same pages render identically from the database.
Unit tests cover the fs repo and a contract test runs against both implementations for loadTeam and saveEvent.

Private fields (guardian phone/email, DOB, medical, coachNotes) live only in tables never selected by the public projection; a test asserts JSON.stringify(getPublicTeam(...)) matches neither /@/ nor /\(\d{3}\)/.
netlify.toml build command is npm ci && npm run build; drizzle migrations are committed and applied by npm run db:migrate.

nodes.title: Identity: coach and admin sessions
nodes.goal: Per-person identity for coaches and admins with no passwords: email code or link sign-in, admin-sent coach invites, server-side revocable sessions, role checks in one helper, and a legacy COACH_PASSCODE shim so the current coaches keep working during migration.
exports: src/lib/auth/session.ts: getSession() -> { user, memberships } | null (per-request cached)
src/lib/auth/session.ts: requireRole(teamId, 'coach'|'admin') -> Actor; throws notFound() on failure (no 403, no enumeration)
src/lib/auth/tokens.ts: createToken(kind, {email, teamId, householdId, role, ttl}) and consumeToken(kind, raw) storing only sha256 hashes
src/lib/mail.ts: sendMail({to, subject, text}) via Resend when RESEND_API_KEY is set, console in dev
src/proxy.ts: coarse check only (session cookie or legacy cookie exists) for /team/*, /admin/*, /api/ai/*
src/lib/auth/legacy.ts: passcode shim producing a synthetic coach actor flagged kind: 'legacy'
acceptance: Coach invite: admin creates an invite for an email; the emailed link /i/<token> signs the coach in on first tap, creates user + membership + session, and is single-use with a 7-day expiry.

Returning coach: /login -> email -> 6-digit code (10-minute expiry, 5 attempts, rate limited per email and IP) -> session cookie gs_session (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, secure in production, 180-day sliding).
requireRole is called in getCoachTeam, the team layout, and every /api/ai/* handler; a coach of team A gets a 404 on team B.
POST /api/auth/logout revokes the server session; 'Sign out everywhere' revokes all of a user's sessions.
Legacy shim: with COACH_PASSCODE set, the existing gs_coach cookie still works and audit entries carry actor.kind='legacy'; with it unset, the shim is inert.
Request-level tests for invite, code login, wrong code, expired token, cross-team access.

nodes.title: Security hardening baseline
nodes.goal: Close the remaining must-fix items from docs/reviews/03-security.md that are not part of another node: share codes, headers, caching, AI route hardening, public projection allowlist, generic errors.
exports: src/lib/ratelimit.ts: limit(key, {max, windowMs}) backed by the database (no external service)
next.config.ts: headers() with HSTS, CSP (frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'self'), Referrer-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy
src/lib/data/getPublicTeam.ts: allowlisted PublicTeam type (no spread of team or events)
prompts/*.md: system prompts contain no user-controlled slots; user text goes in the user turn wrapped as data
acceptance: Share codes are >=96-bit random base64url, stored in share_codes with active/revoked timestamps; /t/<old code> renders 'This link expired, ask your coach'; /t/<unknown> 404s are rate limited per IP.
The public seed and README no longer contain a share code; the import script generates one and prints it once.
curl -I on /team/* shows Cache-Control: private, no-store; coach pages export dynamic = 'force-dynamic'.
Game Day client props carry hasMedical: boolean, never the notes; the messages page builds the BCC mailto server-side behind a click.

AI routes: require a coach session, validate sportTemplateId with z.enum, per-feature max_tokens, maxDuration, per-user daily call cap, generic error strings; a test proves pasted text containing 'ignore previous instructions' lands in the user turn only.
Security headers verified by a test that renders next.config headers().

nodes.title: Schedule editing for coaches
nodes.goal: Coaches add, edit, move, cancel, and delete practices and games from a phone, with weekly repeat for practices and one-tap rain-date activation. Every change is audited and immediately visible to parents.
exports: src/actions/events.ts: createEvent, updateEvent, moveEvent, cancelEvent(undoable), deleteEvent, activateRainDate; all call requireRole then repo, then revalidatePath for /team/[slug] and /t/[code]
src/lib/events/repeat.ts: expandWeekly(template, until) pure and tested
src/lib/events/rainDate.ts: activateRainDate(events, cancelledId, rainDateId) pure and tested
src/components/Sheet.tsx: bottom sheet (phone) / dialog (desktop), focus-trapped, Escape closes
src/components/Toast.tsx: undo toast with 6-second window
src/components/EventSheet.tsx: event detail with coach actions grid (Edit, Move, Cancel, Message families)
src/lib/types.ts: TeamEvent gains rainDateForId?, updatedAt, updatedBy, cancelReason?
acceptance: Tapping any event row (practice or game, coach view) opens EventSheet; Edit shows a form with kind chips from template.eventKinds, date, start/end/arrive, location prefilled from the last event of that kind, opponent and home/away only when kind is the template's contest.
Add event FAB on Schedule; 'Repeat weekly until <date>' creates the series in one action.
Cancel is one tap with an undo toast; the row stays listed with a Cancelled chip; parents see it within one request.
Cancelling a game that has a linked rain date offers 'Play the rain date on <date>'; accepting flips the rain date to scheduled and copies opponent, location, and snack slot.
Every mutation writes an audit row and the sheet shows 'Updated by <first name> <relative time>'.
Works at 400px with one hand: primary action in the bottom third, targets >=48px.

nodes.title: Households and family links for parents
nodes.goal: Give each family an identity without an account: a coach-sent family link that sets a household session, plus a claim-by-masked-email fallback. Parents see their own family's details and can act as their household.
exports: src/lib/auth/family.ts: getFamilySession(teamId) and requireHousehold(teamId, householdId)
src/lib/data/getFamilyTeam.ts: public projection plus the caller's own household (players' full names, own guardians' contacts)
src/app/f/[token]/route.ts: consumes a family_link token, sets gs_family cookie (365 days), redirects to /t/<code>
Coach roster row: 'Copy family link' and 'Reset link' actions
acceptance: Coach roster groups players by household and shows Copy family link (absolute URL) and Reset link per household; reset invalidates the old token and existing family sessions.
Opening a family link on a phone lands on the team page recognised as 'the <label> family' with no form.

Claim fallback: from /t/<code>, 'This is my family' -> pick player -> masked email on file -> 6-digit code -> household session; families with no email on file see 'Ask Coach <name> for your family link'.
Family session never grants coach routes; a test proves /team/* still 404s with only gs_family.
Public roster is unchanged for visitors; a parent sees their own players' full names and contacts with an edit-contacts form that writes only to their household.

nodes.title: Snack sign-up per game
nodes.goal: Parents claim, release, and swap the snack slot for any game from the team page; coaches assign, clear, and see gaps at a glance. Modeled as a generic Signup so volunteer sign-ups come free later.
exports: src/actions/signups.ts: claimSlot(eventId) [requires household], releaseSlot(eventId) [own household or coach], assignSlot(eventId, householdId) [coach], clearSlot(eventId) [coach]; compare-and-set so two families can't both win
src/lib/signups/slots.ts: ensureSlots(events, signups, template) creates one snack slot per contest event, pure and tested
src/components/SnackRow.tsx: three states Claimed by <family> / Open -> I'll bring it / Yours -> Need to swap?
Team.snackGuidelines shown at the top of both snack pages
acceptance: Parent with a household session taps I'll bring it on an open game; the row flips to Yours with an undo toast; release returns it to Open with a 'was the <family>' badge visible to coaches.
Parent without a household session tapping I'll bring it is routed to the claim flow and returned to the same row afterwards.
Coach dashboard chip '<n> games need a snack family' links to the coach Snacks page; each gap has Assign (household picker) and a prefilled 'Ask families' message.
Concurrency test: two simultaneous claims on one slot produce exactly one winner and one friendly error.
Public payload shows only the household label, never a guardian name or contact.
Allergy note from the roster (coach-entered, non-identifying) is pinned at the top of both snack pages when present.

nodes.title: Share the team link
nodes.goal: Coaches and admins can hand parents the team page in one tap: absolute URL, QR code, copy, text, native share, print, and a safe rotate.
exports: src/lib/qr.ts: qrSvg(url, {color}) server-side SVG (qrcode package), no external image host
src/components/ShareTeam.tsx: QR + absolute URL + Copy link / Text it (sms:) / Share (navigator.share when present) / Print
src/actions/share.ts: rotateShareCode(teamId) [coach], undoable within the toast window
acceptance: Settings Sharing card and a More tile both open the Share screen; the URL uses the request host so previews and production differ correctly.
Text it opens the SMS composer prefilled with '<Team> schedule, field and snacks: <url>'.
Rotate shows an undo toast and a note that old links stop working; the old code renders the expired message.
During the first 14 days of a season the coach dashboard hero shows 'Share with families' as its secondary action.

nodes.title: Admin setup: seasons, teams, coaches, wizard save
nodes.goal: An admin sets up a new season or team in the UI, invites coaches, and the AI Season Setup wizard saves its reviewed output through the repository. Remove every 'edit the JSON file' instruction from the product.
exports: src/actions/admin.ts: createSeason, createTeam(from SportTemplate), inviteCoach, removeCoach, archiveTeam; all requireRole('admin')
src/components/SetupWizard.tsx: Save step writes players, households, guardians (private), events, and gear through the repo with a per-row include/exclude toggle
acceptance: /admin lists seasons and teams for the org; New team asks for name, sport template, colors, and creates the team with a fresh share code.
Coach invites are sent from /admin/teams/<id>/coaches and show pending/accepted state.
Wizard Save persists reviewed rows; low-confidence rows default to excluded; guardian contacts go to private tables only.
grep finds no 'data/teams' or '.json' strings in src/app or src/components.
A T-ball team created from the tball template renders every screen with inning-based vocabulary.

nodes.title: Calendar feed and team notice
nodes.goal: Parents subscribe to the schedule in their phone calendar and see any coach notice (field closed, bring water) at the top of the team page.
exports: src/lib/ics.ts: toIcs(events, team) pure and tested (UTC handling for America/Chicago)
GET /t/<code>/calendar.ics with correct content type; per-event 'Add to calendar' link
src/actions/notice.ts: setNotice(teamId, {text, until}) [coach]; NoticeBanner on both home pages
acceptance: Subscribing to the feed in iOS Calendar shows every scheduled event with arrive time in the description; cancelled events carry STATUS:CANCELLED.
Notice appears on /t/<code> and the coach dashboard until its expiry and can be cleared with undo.

nodes.title: UX polish and accessibility pass
nodes.goal: Close the top design findings so the three 'definition of simple' checklists pass: navigation, contrast, tap targets, directions, Game Day one-handed, attendance everywhere, empty states, dark mode, no developer copy.
exports: src/components/AppShell.tsx: BottomNav with aria-current, Lucide icons, team-colored active tab
src/app/globals.css: --text-muted and warning tokens at >=7:1 on their grounds; --team-on-primary-muted
src/actions/attendance.ts: setAttendance(eventId, playerId, status) [coach]; attendance UI on every EventSheet
Game Day: DOM order clock -> lists -> sticky Next button; vibrate + aria-live at 0:00; state persisted per event in localStorage
acceptance: Directions button on every event row and hero using the event's own location.
'Needs attention' chips link to the offending event or player; env warnings appear only in Settings.
All interactive elements >=48px; axe (via Playwright) reports no serious violations on the five main screens in both themes.
Refreshing Game Day mid-game restores attendance, period, and clock.
Every list has an EmptyState with one action; no file paths or env var names render outside Settings.

nodes.title: Migration runbook, CI, privacy notice, docs
nodes.goal: Make the PR safe to merge and operate: zero-downtime migration from COACH_PASSCODE, CI on every push, dependency updates, a short privacy page, and updated README and master prompt.
exports: .github/workflows/ci.yml running npm ci, typecheck, lint, test, build on pull requests
.github/dependabot.yml weekly
docs/MIGRATION.md: steps 1-5 from docs/reviews/04-access-roles.md section 6 with the exact Netlify env changes
/privacy page: what is public, who sees contacts, AI processing, retention, how to opt out of the public roster
acceptance: CI is green on the PR head.
README documents every environment variable with scope (build vs functions) and the db:migrate / db:import commands.
Master prompt and CLAUDE.md reflect the repository interface, sessions, and the household model.
